Centring, measured over the 17 designer icons this project needs:
  mean ink-centre offset from the line-box centre 0.13%, variation between glyphs (stdev) 0.49%
The mean offset is what caused the alignment bug we hit: EB Garamond's symbols sit -8.71% below centre, so a naively centred glyph lands visibly low. Icon fonts sit near zero. The stdev is the part no single correction could fix.
Same metric, same method: Lucide -0.13% / 0.49%  |  Phosphor +0.74% / 1.21%  |  RpgAwesome -0.04% / 0.81%  |  EB Garamond -8.71% / 0.61%
